config.purpose: exploratory archive machine-label adaptation; no human review

labels: Local 9B NF4 machine judgments; require at least 80% structurally valid development outputs before expansion.
evaluation: Full retained archive test; thresholds from archive calibration. Before/after native scalar confidence. Full BANKING77 forgetting after adaptation.
limits: No human ground truth; metrics measure teacher agreement.

Same model family for teacher and student may share systematic errors.
Existing provisional post groups are used; semantic series grouping has not been human audited.
Temperature scaling on mixed candidate-count archive tasks is not included in this first study.
